sectors.implications: Sustained $100+ oil feeds inflation, pressures consumer discretionary, benefits energy equities; Iran resolution would be a major positive catalyst

defensive_moves.recommendation: Shorten bond duration; add TIPS and short-duration treasuries
defensive_moves.rationale: 30Y at 2004 highs, 10Y at 19-year high; further upside limited but equity drag from rate spikes is asymmetric risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce concentration in top 5-10 mega-cap AI names; add breadth
defensive_moves.rationale: Fewer stocks carrying market than dot-com peak; single-name or sector shock could trigger outsized drawdown

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge oil/inflation with energy and gold despite recent gold pullback
defensive_moves.rationale: Iran impasse unresolved; oil at $103; gold tilting lower on rate-hike bets but remains strategic hedge

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid mid-tier consumer discretionary; favor value and essentials
defensive_moves.rationale: Starbucks closing 250 stores, Nike weak demand signal consumer stress; rate sensitivity hurts housing-adjacent spending

defensive_moves.recommendation: De-risk EM exposure ahead of Brazil election and monitor Kenya retail stress
defensive_moves.rationale: Lula's pre-election policy shifts (betting ban, debt relief) create uncertainty; 57.5% sale in Kenya signals structural EM consumer weakness

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Bond selloff and oil-driven inflation fears dominate. Dow/Nasdaq under pressure from 10Y yield spike. Expect volatility in rate-sensitive sectors. AI names may pull back on concentration concerns. Oil likely $100-110 range absent Iran breakthrough. 1-3 month: defensive posture warranted.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle intact per Goldman's Moe; defense spending multi-year; China trade truce provides 2-month window. However, sustained $100+ oil and 5%+ 10Y yield cap equity multiples. 6-12 month: rotation from mega-cap AI into infrastructure, defense, energy, and diagnostics likely outperforms.
